Soy ingeniero de caminos y me dedico a <: I am a civil engineer, and my work is putting information in order with code and artificial intelligence. I come from the projects where you learn that the hard way: six years leading models, data and automation on major international works, where the order of the information sets the deadlines and the costs.
Hoy tengo dos frentes que se alimentan e: Today I work on two fronts that feed each other. I build ONTOS, the system that puts my own life in order, and I bring the same method to people and companies, from their context for AI to a website or a world in 3D.
Los seis años anteriores a ONTOS los pas: I spent the six years before ONTOS on projects where the volume of information outgrows any one person, and the only way through is building systems that keep it in order on their own.
